name: Le Duo Grande 360° Airflow Styler (Blush)
editorialDescription: A flat-iron-shaped 2-in-1 styler that straightens or curls, with air vents around the housing that cool curls as hair leaves the plates. The Grande size has longer 5.3-inch titanium plates, which L'ange recommends for hair below the shoulders. Amazon calls it Le Duo Grande; on L'ange's own site it's the Le Duo Classic in the Grande size.
keyFeatures: Floating titanium plates with rounded edges, 5.3 × 1 in (Grande size)
Air vents around the barrel to cool and set curls
Dual voltage (100–240V), 8.2 ft cord, about 0.9 lb (brand figures)
advantages: One tool for straight styles and curls
Longer plates cover more hair per pass on long or thick hair
A wide temperature range, including lower settings for fine or colour-treated hair
disadvantages: Curling with a flat-iron shape takes practice
430°F is very hot; use the lowest setting that works, with a heat protectant
A 60-minute auto-off leaves it on longer than many tools
Amazon mentions enhanced negative ions, but L'ange's comparison chart doesn't clearly list that feature for the Classic
The Grande size can be awkward on short hair
suits: People who want to curl and straighten with one tool
skipIf: Your hair is at or above the shoulders (the Standard size suits that better)
You prefer a curling wand or an automatic curler
buyingConsiderations: Choose between the Grande and Standard sizes by hair length
This listing is the Blush colour
Check that the seller is L'ange Hair Inc.
If an ion generator matters to you, compare with Le Duo Edge or Le Duo Flex
